scope: Component-level behavioral audit of all currently modeled hardware and major missing original driver domains. This is an evidence-backed first pass, not proof that every driver path or all original modules are equivalent.
comparison_policy: Use exact live OEM artifacts when available; label GPL/BSP sources separately because their bytes often differ.
Compare explicit state ownership, page/bank selection, reset/clock order, firmware ABI, memory/DMA layout, errors, teardown and cold/warm recovery.
Require negative-path and final-image checks; successful initialization, a version string or a single link bit is insufficient.
Keep intentional protective differences distinct from implementation defects and missing coverage.

components.evidence_and_difference: Original air_ref_clk_speed selects standard page before AUX read; native callback assumed page 0. Actual PHY15 was on page 4: raw AUX=0, page-0 AUX=0x28.
components.required_action_and_validation: Use phy_read_paged; keep normal decoding and MDIO error propagation. Live 1000/full and three reopen cycles checked; image/cold-boot validation recorded separately.

components.evidence_and_difference: M65 guarded private ART EEPROM loading in build_dir, but its patch was not persisted in the package patch queue. Installed M73 mt7996e lacks its marker and logs reference EEPROM fallback despite the private 7680-byte input being present.
components.required_action_and_validation: M75 persists the M65 patch, verifies prepared source and final module/private input hashes, and cold-boots with the private ART marker and no reference fallback. Deliberately invalid calibration was rejected. Recovery after failed binding is tracked separately and did not pass.

components.evidence_and_difference: Original live DT has a thermal sensor at 0x1efbd000 and a CPU thermal zone. Native DT omits them; runtime has cooling devices but no temperature zones.
components.required_action_and_validation: Port the AN7583 sensor/calibration and cooling bindings; validate plausible temperature against original system, trips and recovery before sustained load. No thermal protection equivalence is claimed.

components.evidence_and_difference: Native cpufreq probe returns ENOENT for the cpu clock and has no policies. Original DT has OPP/frequency controllers. Two CPUs and PSCI/hotplug working does not establish clock scaling.
components.required_action_and_validation: Implement the actual CPU clock/OPP contract, not a guessed fixed clock. Compare measured operating rates and transition order under load and hotplug.

components.evidence_and_difference: Native /sys/class/watchdog is empty. Neither driver registration nor an armed watchdog was observed; the original watchdog baseline is still incomplete.
components.required_action_and_validation: Identify original watchdog ownership and reset reason handling, then test bounded expiry, normal feeding and recovery. Do not claim hang recovery from panic=10 or rescue-core existence.

components.evidence_and_difference: Both native endpoints currently reach 5 GT/s x1, matching the original post-driver RAM baseline. The development port-0 initialization pulses a shared reset; port-1 relies on observed probe ordering. Root-port 1 also reports an unassigned 8-GiB BAR0.
components.required_action_and_validation: Make shared-reset ownership/order explicit and test reversed probe/deferred probe, unbind/rebind and error recovery. Preserve endpoint BAR success separately from the root-port warning.

components.evidence_and_difference: Native external eth1 and eth2 have random address assignment type 1; startup logs show generated random addresses. Fixed factory identity has not been wired into these MAC devices.
components.required_action_and_validation: Locate and validate each factory address source and port mapping; require stable, distinct addresses across cold boots. Do not invent ART offsets or publish device addresses.

components.evidence_and_difference: Measured GPIO35 resets PHY15 and GPIO34 resets PHY14. Native production DT lacks GPIO reset bindings. Original RAM baseline used PHY driver 1.2.12 / firmware 25080112; native uses firmware 25062302.
components.required_action_and_validation: Integrate reset through the GPIO/PHY framework; compare cold/warm/reopen paths and both port roles. Keep firmware revisions explicit; a version difference alone is not proof of failure and is not the cause of the confirmed AUX-page bug.

components.evidence_and_difference: M72 corrected PON electrical RX/CDR initialization. M75 1G peer data on eth2 now passes, but prior intermittent dual-2500 carrier and failed paired frames did not qualify eth1 or true 2.5G traffic.
components.required_action_and_validation: Test eth1 independently, then genuine 2.5G peers and frame integrity/reopen at each speed. Review ownership before enabling the DSL/PON transport; do not infer copper health from PCS link bits.

components.evidence_and_difference: Original NPU firmware/layout and native host API differ from generic assumptions: GET_INFO works while generic GET_VERSION is unsupported. M69 fixed stale flow cookies; M70 validated repeated IPv4 TCP/UDP hardware flow cleanup. Native PPE hardware byte counters are disabled.
components.required_action_and_validation: Preserve firmware/layout/hash gates and independent CPU-bypass evidence. Test IPv6, VLAN, PPPoE, MTU/fragments, simultaneous traffic, link loss and teardown before provider forwarding qualification. Zero PPE counters do not prove inactivity.

components.evidence_and_difference: Native combined AEAD accepted tampered tags in an earlier board test. The current board-specific guard disables that registration and uses generic authenc over hardware AES/HMAC; 34 oracle cases and 48 tamper rejections passed.
components.required_action_and_validation: Retain fail-closed combined-AEAD policy and recheck the guard in final source/image. Extend to workload concurrency and intended VPN modes; copying original registration behavior is not automatically correct.

components.evidence_and_difference: Original NAND code may rebuild/write BBT/BMT; native policy preserves factory mapping and only admits the 319-PEB system body. Geometry/ECC and protected readbacks passed. Runtime bad-block retirement is deliberately disabled. Current slot0 ECC corrected bits are nonzero with zero uncorrectable errors; counts alone do not establish new damage.
components.required_action_and_validation: Keep anchor/map checks and separate factory BMT reserve from UBI reserve. Qualify erase/program failure handling, scrub/read-disturb, power loss and wear before a production release; do not repair/reclaim factory areas automatically.

components.evidence_and_difference: Original live DT exposes xHCI and USB PHY/SerDes resources. Native DT has no USB controller/PHY nodes; no USB devices or root hubs enumerate. Registered platform driver names alone do not mean hardware initialization.
components.required_action_and_validation: Port the original resource, reset, clock, VBUS and lane ownership contract; test USB2/USB3 enumeration, hotplug, DMA and power. The workstation USB NIC does not test the router USB host.

components.evidence_and_difference: UART works; external reset mapping and recovery Reset GPIO were measured. Linux board GPIO, LED/pinctrl and button handling are not complete; switch PHY LED pinctrl reports a failure. Physical held-Reset cold-entry remains untested.
components.required_action_and_validation: Model GPIO/pinctrl ownership instead of inheriting bootloader values. Test polarity/debounce and user-visible LEDs, then physical recovery entry independently of COM3/SP3 boot.

components.evidence_and_difference: Original hsm/iNIC/endpoint firmware and shared metadata/transport behavior are recorded; native host lifecycle and provider replay are only partially implemented. Native Ethernet carrier or a provider preset cannot establish DSL synchronization, automatic credentials or provisioning.
components.required_action_and_validation: Reproduce original reset/clock/image/metadata/interrupt ordering and reconnect states; attach the owner line only after notification. Verify line synchronization, autonomous Internet connection and provider provisioning separately.

components.evidence_and_difference: Available voice BSP contains legacy 5.4 binary modules/libraries and no selected C implementation. Several live and BSP executable/relocation sections differ; matching symbols or a successful module build does not prove ABI or behavior compatibility.
components.required_action_and_validation: Map the exact live DSP/PCM/SLIC lifecycle, interrupt, DMA and userspace ABI. Implement/adapt for 6.18 and test provisioning, ring/hook/audio paths with the real hardware.

components.evidence_and_difference: M73 installs and upgrades with retained configuration, protected-region readback and cold boot. Normal M73 and independent M54 rescue remain separate; slot0 is intact. Missing mktemp previously showed generic stage2 success text is insufficient. Health acknowledgement, trial counts and power-loss rollback are absent.
components.required_action_and_validation: Retain image/runtime dependency gates, exact volume hashes and independent reboot evidence. Test interruption and physical rescue; make stage2 prewrite failures explicit in future backend hardening.

components.evidence_and_difference: A controlled repeat read back the restored firmware search path before rebinding valid input. Rebinding still produced duplicate MSI/MSI-X enable warnings, firmware/patch semaphore timeouts, reset-work warnings and IRQ40 disable/unhandled interrupts. Native mt7996/pci.c allocates HIF2 vectors in primary probe while primary removal only puts HIF2 and unregisters the device. This is an observed failure path; exact interrupt/resource causal ownership is still under review.
components.required_action_and_validation: Review and repair primary/HIF2 IRQ ownership, quiescence and probe-error work cancellation. Validate normal primary-only unbind/rebind, failed initialization followed by good calibration, repeated full module unload/reload and cold recovery. Do not count invalid-input rejection alone as successful recovery. The first fixture also had an unverified empty sysfs write; the repeat explicitly verified restoration and reproduced the failure.

native_source_sites.purpose: HIF2 vector allocation from primary probe

coverage.original_module_inventory: 86 distinct loaded modules captured; not all receive instruction-level equivalence analysis in this pass
coverage.runtime_sweep: 12 read-only command groups; raw logs and identifiers remain private

fix_build_gates: 23 source hashes: 14 M72 integration prerequisites, EN8811H, mt76 EEPROM and seven NAND admission/protection sources
Persistent kernel and package patch queues
Final SquashFS and installer runtime module/calibration identity
Cold-boot private calibration marker and no default fallback
Observed 1000/full, port reopen and bidirectional data integrity
